keyRecommendations.text: There is no definitive standardised guideline for evaluation, diagnosis, and treatment.
Three-phase dynamic bronchoscopy is described as the gold standard for diagnosis.
Most surgeons use more than 50% dynamic narrowing on forced exhalation or coughing as the endoscopic diagnostic threshold, although no standard criterion exists.

clinicalBottomLine: In this paediatric review, TBM is diagnosed by direct dynamic endoscopy, most often using a greater than 50% expiratory or cough-related collapse, and airway narrowing is accentuated in expiration.
notableCaveats: The accepted review is a paediatric overview. Adult acquired TBM is not its population.
